Liam — appreciate the heads up and glad the workshop helped. Short answer: yes, we can do a timebox extension. Two pragmatic paths that map to procurement preferences:

1) Deterministic addendum (preferred for purchase orders): we add a 9-business-day addendum priced as a fixed ‘extension SKU’ — essentially a discounted rate for the extended window; price is predictable and billable as a single line.

2) Escape-hatch bucket: pre-purchase an hour-pool at a flat hourly rate that only gets consumed if you exceed the base pilot. This gives unit pricing but is still a bounded, pre-purchased item on the PO.

I’ve copied Marissa (CS) and David (Solutions) to validate the operational impact and estimated usage. We can draft both options in an addendum and attach for procurement review.

Next step: David — can you confirm expected additional token/hour estimate from your end so we can size the hour-pool and the fixed SKU? Marissa — can you flag any SLA/rollback concerns for the extended window?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 02 Mar 2027 at 16:03, tessa_morgan wrote:
> Next step: David — can you confirm expected additional token/hour estimate from your end so we can size the hour-pool and the fixed SKU?

Liam — I ran a quick pass against your current usage patterns (attached workbook) and projection for the new schema. If nothing else changes, the 9 business days should consume roughly: 1) 18k additional prompts, ~2.5M tokens processed, or 120 GPU-hours under the current Dedicated profile you tested with.

Recommendation: If procurement wants a single-line predictable charge, price the fixed addendum as a 10k token-equivalent block priced at 40% off list, billed as 3 blocks (covers variance) — that yields a single invoice line and avoids hourly accounting.

If you prefer the hour-pool (escape hatch), size it to 140 GPU-hours (buffered) and offer a slightly lower per-hour than on-demand since it's pre-paid. Either way, both are bounded and PO-friendly.

I attached the projection and a simple sensitivity tab.

—David Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sarah / Liam — thanks. We discussed internally and drafted a short addendum you can attach to your PO. Summary:

- Fixed extension SKU: covers 9 business days of pilot runway, priced at $18,750. This price is calculated from David's projected consumption (3 x 10k token blocks) with a 40% pilot discount. It is billed as a single line item and will appear as "Pilot Extension — 9 business days" on the invoice.

- Fallback cap: if actual usage > 2x projected, Redwood will notify Stellar and pause additional processing until approval; any extra consumption can be handled via a pre-agreed hour-pool at $145/hour (pre-purchased in 20-hour increments) or a pro-rata invoice at on-demand rates.

- No change to data retention or access: your data controls and log access remain the same for the extension window.

Attached: redwood-pilot-addendum-draft-v2.pdf (language for legal / procurement), plus David's usage workbook.

Requested next steps: Sarah — if that fixed line works for procurement, please confirm and we'll route the addendum to Legal for a quick signature. If procurement wants the hour-pool instead, we can swap to that wording and send a new addendum.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
